gallery.title: File:Lower Mainland of British Columbia, 2012.jpg
gallery.artist: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center from Greenbelt, MD, USA
gallery.description: I took NASA's beautiful satellite image of the Fraser Lowland from 2012 and cropped into the core area of the Lower Mainland. I also added an approximate Canada-US border line meant for visual reference. This image is meant to replace an older satellite image that outlining the Lower Mainland in red.
